name: Power Surge 1
desc: Mita's attack damage rises by 2. \nA basic upgrade for combat efficiency.

name: Power Surge 2
desc: Mita's attack damage rises by 2. \nFurther improves combat efficiency.

name: Quick Draw 1
desc: Mita's attack speed rises by 0.2. \nThe attack cycle is shortened.

name: Swift Round 1
desc: The speed of Mita's bullets rises by 0.2. \nAids accuracy on ranged attacks.

name: Heavy Round 1
desc: The size of Mita's bullets rises by 0.2. \nStabilizes the attack hitbox.

name: Swift Round 2
desc: The speed of Mita's bullets rises by 0.2. \nYou'll be able to hit enemies faster.

name: Long Sight 1
desc: Mita's attack range rises by 2. \nMakes combat possible from a safer\ndistance.

name: Power Surge 3
desc: Mita's attack damage rises by 2. \nNo need to fear even when entering\ndeeper caves.

name: Quick Draw 2
desc: Mita's attack speed rises by 0.2. \nContinuous-attack capability is reinforced.

name: Heavy Mod 1
desc: Mita’s attack power increases by 5, but\nattack speed decreases by 0.4. \nA setup for maximum output.

name: Power Surge 4
desc: Mita's attack damage rises by 3. \nMita braces for combat before entering\na high-risk cave.

name: Rapid Mod 1
desc: Mita's attack speed rises by 0.4 and range\ndrops by 5.\nNo fear of close combat either.

name: Quick Draw 3
desc: Mita's attack speed rises by 0.2. \nShows an attack cadence faster than\nanyone else.

name: Long Sight 3
desc: Mita's attack range rises by 2. \nAt this point you could call her a sniper.

name: The Delver's Gun
desc: Mita’s attack power Increases by 5, range\nby 3, and attack Speed by 0.2. Refitted\ninto a firearm worthy of a true delver.

name: Composure 1
desc: When Mita finishes a target with an\nexecution, the Fragile gauge recovers by 5.

name: Finisher's Reach 1
desc: Mita's execution range rises by 5. \nMakes it easier to seize execution chances.

name: Finisher's Blast 1
desc: Executions now deal damage to\nsurrounding enemies. Will come in\nhandy during combat.

name: Finisher's Reach 2
desc: Mita's execution range rises by 5. \nMakes it easier to execute from afar.

name: Finisher's Blast 2
desc: The damage dealt to surrounding enemies\non execution rises. Lets you set up\nchained execution opportunities.

name: Composure 2
desc: When Mita finishes a target with an\nexecution, the Fragile gauge recovers by 5. \nEases the burden of a long delve.

name: Second Wind 1
desc:
When Mita finishes a target with an
execution, one dash charge is restored. 
Flows straight from a finisher into the
next move.

name: Comrade's Gift
desc:
When Mita finishes a target with an
execution, health recovers by 0.5. 
A gift from someone who was once
a comrade.

name: Second Wind 2
desc: When Mita finishes a target with an\nexecution, one dash charge is restored. \nFast executions! fast evasions!

name: Vigor 1
desc: Mita's health rises by 1. \nLets her hold out a little longer in battle.

name: Vigor 2
desc: Mita's health rises by 1. \nYour margin for survival grows.

name: Steady Mind 1
desc: Mita's Fragile gauge cap rises by 10. \nGives you mental breathing room.

name: Resilience 1
desc: When Mita clears a dungeon, health\nrecovers by 0.5.\nMaybe dungeons aren't all bad after all.

name: Vigor 3
desc: Mita's health rises by 1. \nBase health is reinforced.

name: Steady Nerves 1
desc: Mita's Fragile gauge growth rate drops\nby 0.2. It takes longer to reach the\nmental breaking point.

name: Steady Recovery 1
desc: When Mita clears a dungeon, the Fragile\ngauge recovers by 5. \nMore peace of mind than you'd expect.

name: Iron Grit 1
desc: Invincibility frames after being hit rise\nby 0.1 seconds. Gives you immunity\nto follow-up damage.

name: Resilience 2
desc: When Mita clears a dungeon, health\nrecovers by 0.5. Dungeons are starting to\nfeel a little familiar.

name: Steady Mind 2
desc: Mita's Fragile gauge cap rises by 10. \nRecommended for long expeditions.

name: Resilience 3
desc: When Mita clears a dungeon, health\nrecovers by 0.5. You'll need this to delve\ninto the deeper dungeons.

name: Steady Nerves 2
desc: Mita's Fragile gauge growth rate drops\nby 0.3. Eases the mental breaking point\nover the long haul.

name: Steady Recovery 2
desc: When Mita clears a dungeon, the Fragile\ngauge recovers by 10. \nEnter the next stage in a stable state.

name: Light Step 1
desc: Mita's movement speed rises by 1. \nMobility is reinforced.

name: Afterburn 1
desc: When Mita dashes, movement speed rises\nby 0.5 for 1 second. Lets her open distance\nquickly after a dash.

name: Long Stride 1
desc: Mita's dash distance rises by 1. \nLets her open distance faster in\ndangerous moments.

name: Light Step 2
desc: Mita's movement speed rises by 1. \nMobility is greatly reinforced.

name: Charge-In 1
desc: When Mita dashes, attack power rises\nby 1 for 1 second. Lets her follow a dash\nwith a powerful attack.

name: Long Stride 2
desc: Mita's dash distance rises by 1. \nBoth approach and escape become easy.

name: Phase Dash 1
desc: Mita's dash invincibility duration rises\nby 0.25 seconds. Enemy attacks just\ngraze her.

name: Quick Charge 1
desc: Mita's dash recharge time drops by 0.05\nseconds. The rhythm of dashing never\nbreaks.

name: Afterburn 2
desc: When Mita dashes, movement speed rises\nby 1 for 2 seconds. \nSpecializes in movement and evasion.

name: Phase Dash 2
desc: Mita's dash invincibility duration rises\nby 0.25 seconds. Makes bold entries\npossible even in danger.

name: Quick Charge 2
desc: Mita's dash recharge time drops by 0.05\nseconds. No one can keep up with\nMita's movement.

name: Charge-In 2
desc: When Mita dashes, attack power rises by\n4 for 1 second. Fast entries! heavy hits!
